review_snippets: This home is a guest favorite based on ratings, reviews, and reliability

We had an excellent stay.  It was perfect to unwind on a guys golf weekend.  First time in the area but we would definitely stay there again.  They had great recommendations and were responsive to all questions!  Wonderful house, it had it all!

We stayed for my brothers bachelor party. The house was absolutely perfect for the occasion, but would work for any occasion. There was plenty of space and plenty to do at the house as well as within Scottsdale. Everything was clean and modern inside the house. The host and pints of contact were very helpful and pleasant. We would absolutely come back.
We had a great stay. The hosts were very communicative and helpful, and the house was awesome with all of the amenities.
Great house, looked exactly like the photos. Would definitely stay again.
An amazing house in a great neighborhood! Great amenities that were all well maintained. The host(s) were also very helpful, friendly, and responsive!
